scripts.docker:db:seed: docker compose run --rm app npm run db:seed
scripts.docker:db:unseed: docker compose run --rm app npm run db:unseed
scripts.docker:db:reset: docker compose run --rm app npm run db:reset
scripts.docker:unit: docker compose run --rm app npm run jest:unit
scripts.docker:integ: docker compose run --rm app npm run jest:integ
scripts.test:e2e: npm run docker:db:seed && npm run docker:e2e; npm run docker:db:unseed
scripts.test:full: npm run test:unit; npm run test:integ; npm run test:e2e
